Models: open to gpt-like open models, prefers mid-sized quantized models for cost/latency tradeoffs. Routing/fallback: wants fallback to smaller model when quota exceeded. Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS for key management. Data residency: must support EU merchant data routing or clear contractual assurances.
